activeCountyIdentity.finding: Window identity, then selected awareness county, then Liberty default; setter updates identity and owns county-change activation.

manifestLookup.finding: Fetches the production manifest no-store, normalizes entries, and resolves only the requested county.

localSource.finding: Validated registry roadSegmentsPath wins and is fetched as a single FeatureCollection; Montgomery alone is integrity-checked gzip.

remoteSingle.finding: external_runtime HTTPS URL is selected and fetched once, validated as nonempty line geometry, then committed only while request remains active.

harrisLegacyPartitions.finding: Harris-only LP032.2 manifest, viewport/seed selection, bounded queue/cache, generation guard, stable-segment assembly.

genericLp210Partitions.finding: For seven governed counties, fetches the certified manifest and every declared part; any HTTP failure or zero line geometry fails closed before commit.

countyLifecycle.finding: A changed county advances transition generation, clears awareness/crossing ownership, starts roadway activation, and refreshes visible surfaces.

staleClearing.finding: Geometry and loaded flag are cleared before every load and on active-request failure; resolver cache is reset.

nearestRoad.finding: Scans active geometry within 1.2 miles, validates name/ref/highway, may pair a nearby road, then uses crossing fallback.

roadNameExtraction.finding: Uses feature properties name, ref, highway through county-aware candidate validation.

hazardReportConsumption.finding: Coordinate association invokes resolveNearestRoadName; report narratives and placement audits consume its result.

awarenessContext.finding: Selected awareness area can establish county identity; mismatched persisted awareness is moved to the new county-wide area before roadway activation.

failureAndMalformed.finding: HTTP, JSON, wrong FeatureCollection, empty/malformed lines, or missing partitions leave geometry empty for an active request; Harris failed entries contain no features.

priorCountyReusePrevention.finding: Pre-clear plus county-and-sequence requestStillActive guard suppress late commits; Harris uses an independent generation guard.

wrongCountyFallbackPrevention.finding: Resolver returns a no-URL blocked source rather than Liberty or another county; fallbackUsed is reset false and no fallback fetch exists.
